serialization_protocol=True | not applicable | {"entity_macro": "not applicable", "format": "not applicable", "markup": "not applicable", "structure": "branch"} | {"decisions_sha256": "aaf69923f0f2a5b9bbdf4002a52af4cfc8b32a3bd643693ef9ff633c9f46c3f0", "glossary_sha256": "02dced6890bd280bb3d38992968a740c167f8a10c33e9edf0bf0b9eb71c5a96c"} | ["branch"] | {"enum": "crawl-ref/source/branch-type.h", "initializer": "crawl-ref/source/branch-data.h", "lifecycle_producer": "crawl-ref/source/branch.cc"} | {"chinese_description": "深渊确实是个怪诞、不断变化且扭曲的地方。里面充满各种怪物，大多具有恶魔本性，共同目标都是吞食闯入者。这里也是许多术士的垃圾场；他们乐于把你这样的准英雄送进这片疯狂试炼场。据说混沌中仍存在某种结构，因为卢格努似乎围绕此地及其居民策划着阴谋。\n\n地牢后段的某一层受到深渊侵蚀，可以在那里找到许多通往深渊的传送门。\n\n深渊由七个无尽层面构成。自第三层起便可能找到深渊符文，越深入就越常见。返回地牢的传送门散布于深渊各处，在更深处或携带深渊符文时更常出现。\n\n杀死怪物会扭曲深渊的物质，最终生成离开的通道。继续坚持则会在深渊上磨出孔洞，让人得以下降到更深层面。\n\n深渊的结构会更加留意强者；无论如何抵达，经验越丰富的冒险者越会发现自己被拖向这片疯狂无垠领域的更深处。", "current": {"description": "深渊确实是个怪诞、不断变化且扭曲的地方。里面充满各种怪物，大多具有恶魔本性，共同目标都是吞食闯入者。这里也是许多术士的垃圾场；他们乐于把你这样的准英雄送进这片疯狂试炼场。据说混沌中仍存在某种结构，因为卢格努似乎围绕此地及其居民策划着阴谋。\n\n地牢后段的某一层受到深渊侵蚀，可以在那里找到许多通往深渊的传送门。\n\n深渊由七个无尽层面构成。自第三层起便可能找到深渊符文，越深入就越常见。返回地牢的传送门散布于深渊各处，在更深处或携带深渊符文时更常出现。\n\n杀死怪物会扭曲深渊的物质，最终生成离开的通道。继续坚持则会在深渊上磨出孔洞，让人得以下降到更深层面。\n\n深渊的结构会更加留意强者；无论如何抵达，经验越丰富的冒险者越会发现自己被拖向这片疯狂无垠领域的更深处。", "entry_message": null, "longname": "深渊", "shortname": "深渊"}, "english_description": "The Abyss is a truly bizarre place, ever-changing and twisted. It is filled\nwith all sorts of monsters, mostly of demonic nature, whose common aim is to\nfeast on intruders. It is also the garbage dump for many sorcerers, who delight\nin sending would-be champions like you to these proving grounds of madness.\nReportedly, there is some structure to the chaos, as Lugonu seems to concoct\nschemes around this place and its denizens.\n\nMany portals to the Abyss can be found corrupting one floor late in the Dungeon.\n\nThe Abyss consists of seven infinite levels. The abyssal rune of Zot can be\nfound from the third level onwards, and is more common at greater depths.\nPortals back to the dungeon are scattered throughout the Abyss, and are found\nmore commonly at greater depths or while carrying the abyssal rune.\n\nKilling monsters will warp the substance of the Abyss, eventually generating a\ngateway out. Further persistence will wear holes in the Abyss, allowing descent\ninto deeper layers.\n\nThe fabric of the Abyss takes greater notice of the powerful; no matter how\nthey arrive, more experienced adventurers will find themselves drawn deeper\nwithin the maddening expanse of that realm.", "evidence": ["crawl-ref/source/branch-type.h", "crawl-ref/source/branch-data.h", "crawl-ref/source/branch.cc", "crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt", "crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/branches.txt"], "final_glossary": "02dced6890bd280bb3d38992968a740c167f8a10c33e9edf0bf0b9eb71c5a96c", "frozen_inventory": "d366ce3e52feac26fbbbaf641aafc1c99c938ec36b9f9cee644303cc15f8404d", "reason": "扭曲领域与施法者放逐场、卢格努、后期一层入口、七层/第三层起符文及越深越常见、携符文更易出口、杀敌生出口及下行、强者引往深处均完整。"} | 深渊 | 无确定替代案；保留当前文本及既定术语 | high | none | not applicable — terminal decision | keep; 扭曲领域与施法者放逐场、卢格努、后期一层入口、七层/第三层起符文及越深越常见、携符文更易出口、杀敌生出口及下行、强者引往深处均完整。 |

"万魔殿是一片无边无际、充满痛苦与折磨的领域。虽然其中藏有许多宝藏，却由残酷的恶魔和更加残酷的恶魔领主把守。\n\n深处遍布通往万魔殿的传送门。\n\n万魔殿没有尽头。每个区域都有小概率出现返回地牢的传送门，或是直接返回，或是经由深渊返回。\n\n万魔殿中可以找到不少于五种佐特符文：\n • 炽热符文位于塞雷波夫的烈焰领域\n • 发光符文可在姆诺雷格受污染的领地中找到\n • 魔法符文由洛姆·洛邦的奥术力量守护\n • 黑暗符文藏在格洛克斯·弗洛克的暗影居所\n • 恶魔符文散见多处，归名气较小的领主所有", "current": {"description": While a portal to\nsafety will be present on every level, once left, a ziggurat cannot be\nre-entered.\n\nOne ziggurat is guaranteed in the Depths. Tales tell of a magical item found\nat the bottom of each ziggurat, granting access to a new ziggurat in turn. Such\nan item is also said to be found at the bottom of the Tomb of the Ancients. Each\ntime a ziggurat is conquered by exiting it from the final floor, subsequent\nziggurats will become increasingly dangerous and lucrative.", "evidence": ["crawl-ref/source/branch-type.h", "crawl-ref/source/branch-data.h", "crawl-ref/source/branch.cc", "crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt", "crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/branches.txt"], "final_glossary": "02dced6890bd280bb3d38992968a740c167f8a10c33e9edf0bf0b9eb71c5a96c", "frozen_inventory": "d366ce3e52feac26fbbbaf641aafc1c99c938ec36b9f9cee644303cc15f8404d", "reason": "由逐大竞技场构成、逐层更富更险、每层出口且不可重返、深处保证一座、塔底及陵墓底物品、最终层征服后增险增富完整。"} | 通天塔 | 无确定替代案；保留当前文本及既定术语 | high | none | not applicable — terminal decision | keep; 由逐大竞技场构成、逐层更富更险、每层出口且不可重返、深处保证一座、塔底及陵墓底物品、最终层征服后增险增富完整。 |

| `world_description:branches:abyss` | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt; database.cc:getLongDescription | lookup by retained English key; reachability reviewed separately; description | persistent=False; protocol=True | The Abyss is a truly bizarre place, ever-changing and twisted. It is filled with all sorts of monsters, mostly of demonic nature, whose common aim is to feast on intruders. It is also the garbage dump for many sorcerers, who delight in sending would-be champions like you to these proving grounds of madness. Reportedly, there is some structure to the chaos, as Lugonu seems to concoct schemes around this place and its denizens. Many portals to the Abyss can be found corrupting one floor late in the Dungeon. The Abyss consists of seven infinite levels. The abyssal rune of Zot can be found from the third level onwards, and is more common at greater depths. Portals back to the dungeon are scattered throughout the Abyss, and are found more commonly at greater depths or while carrying the abyssal rune. Killing monsters will warp the substance of the Abyss, eventually generating a gateway out. Further persistence will wear holes in the Abyss, allowing descent into deeper layers. The fabric of the Abyss takes greater notice of the powerful; no matter how they arrive, more experienced adventurers will find themselves drawn deeper within the maddening expanse of that realm. | 深渊确实是个怪诞、不断变化且扭曲的地方。里面充满各种怪物，大多具有恶魔本性，共同目标都是吞食闯入者。这里也是许多术士的垃圾场；他们乐于把你这样的准英雄送进这片疯狂试炼场。据说混沌中仍存在某种结构，因为卢格努似乎围绕此地及其居民策划着阴谋。 地牢后段的某一层受到深渊侵蚀，可以在那里找到许多通往深渊的传送门。 深渊由七个无尽层面构成。自第三层起便可能找到深渊符文，越深入就越常见。返回地牢的传送门散布于深渊各处，在更深处或携带深渊符文时更常出现。 杀死怪物会扭曲深渊的物质，最终生成离开的通道。继续坚持则会在深渊上磨出孔洞，让人得以下降到更深层面。 深渊的结构会更加留意强者；无论如何抵达，经验越丰富的冒险者越会发现自己被拖向这片疯狂无垠领域的更深处。 | {"dynamic_parameters": null, "sink_kind": "TextDB description", "tokens": {"chinese": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}, "english": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}}, "translated_dynamic_parameters": null} | retained_textdb | description | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt | database.cc:getLongDescription | {"dynamic_parameters": null, "sink_kind": "TextDB description", "tokens": {"chinese": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}, "english": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}}, "translated_dynamic_parameters": null} | {"category": "world_description", "conditions": "lookup by retained English key; It is filled\nwith all sorts of monsters, mostly of demonic nature, whose common aim is to\nfeast on intruders. It is also the garbage dump for many sorcerers, who delight\nin sending would-be champions like you to these proving grounds of madness.\nReportedly, there is some structure to the chaos, as Lugonu seems to concoct\nschemes around this place and its denizens.\n\nMany portals to the Abyss can be found corrupting one floor late in the Dungeon.\n\nThe Abyss consists of seven infinite levels. | `world_description:branches:dungeon` | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt; database.cc:getLongDescription | lookup by retained English key; reachability reviewed separately; description | persistent=False; protocol=True | It is still a mystery how this bizarre place was created. | `world_description:branches:gulch` | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt; database.cc:getLongDescription | lookup by retained English key; reachability reviewed separately; description | persistent=False; protocol=True | As the upper Dungeon has its sewer drainage system, so too do the Vaults. These gutter gulches serve as a containment space for accumulated garbage, various abandoned experiments, disorderly encroaching pests, and the particularly-broken corpses of intruders all alike. A great deal of mutagenic energy emanates from the mystic slag and mouldy waters running through it, such that even crossing its threshold will temporarily mutate new guests. Still, the widely-renowned defences of the Vaults would never dismiss any potential security front: mild maintenance via punished guards manage just barely enough direction to send such gulch monstrosities at anybody who would dare try to extract hidden riches from such filthy chambers. | 正如地牢上层有下水道排水系统，宝库也有自己的排水设施。 这些排污渠收纳着堆积的垃圾、各种废弃实验、四处滋生的害虫， 以及闯入者被毁坏得格外严重的尸体。流经这里的神秘熔渣和发霉污水散发出大量诱变能量， 甚至只要跨过门槛，新来的访客就会暂时发生变异。 然而，以严密防御闻名的宝库绝不会忽视任何一道潜在防线： 被罚到此处的守卫勉强维持着最低限度的维护，所能施加的管束也仅够驱使这些污渠怪物， 扑向任何胆敢从这般污秽的密室里挖掘暗藏宝物的人。 | {"dynamic_parameters": null, "sink_kind": "TextDB description", "tokens": {"chinese": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}, "english": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}}, "translated_dynamic_parameters": null} | retained_textdb | description | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt | database.cc:getLongDescription | {"dynamic_parameters": null, "sink_kind": "TextDB description", "tokens": {"chinese": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}, "english": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}}, "translated_dynamic_parameters": null} | {"category": "world_description", "conditions": "lookup by retained English key; | `world_description:branches:necropolis` | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt; database.cc:getLongDescription | lookup by retained English key; reachability reviewed separately; description | persistent=False; protocol=True | While many locales across the Dungeon are dedicated to the long-interred restless dead, those whose remains are fresh or lost are collected in the floating ceremonial chambers of the Necropolis. Each soul is enshrined and tended to by the maintenance staff recreating both their lives and their moments of death, helping visitors bid farewell to the departed. With the advent of adventurers seeking the Orb of Zot, these realms have been repurposed: such ghosts are blinded by rage and impossible to control, so both they and their stolen possessions are sealed away in these realms of reconciliation. | 地牢各处有许多地点属于久埋地下却不得安息的亡者；而遗骸尚且新鲜或已然遗失的死者，则被收集到死灵城浮空的仪式厅中。每个灵魂都受到供奉，由维护人员悉心照料；他们重现亡者的生平与死亡时刻，帮助访客向逝者告别。随着追寻佐特宝珠的冒险者出现，这些领域被改作他用：这类鬼魂被愤怒蒙蔽，根本无法控制，于是它们及其被盗走的财物都被封存在这些和解之境中。 | {"dynamic_parameters": null, "sink_kind": "TextDB description", "tokens": {"chinese": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}, "english": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}}, "translated_dynamic_parameters": null} | retained_textdb | description | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt | database.cc:getLongDescription | {"dynamic_parameters": null, "sink_kind": "TextDB description", "tokens": {"chinese": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}, "english": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}}, "translated_dynamic_parameters": null} | {"category": "world_description", "conditions": "lookup by retained English key; | `world_description:branches:pandemonium` | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt; database.cc:getLongDescription | lookup by retained English key; reachability reviewed separately; description | persistent=False; protocol=True | Pandemonium is an infinite realm of pain and suffering. While there are many treasures to be found within, they are guarded by cruel demons and even crueller demon lords. Portals to Pandemonium are found abundantly in the Depths. Pandemonium is endless. Each area of Pandemonium has a small chance of containing a portal back to the dungeon, either directly or via the Abyss. No fewer than five runes of Zot can be found in Pandemonium: • the fiery rune resides in the blazing realm of Cerebov • the glowing rune can be found in the contaminated domain of Mnoleg • the magical rune is guarded by the arcane powers of Lom Lobon • the dark rune is hidden in the shadowy abode of Gloorx Vloq • the demonic rune exists in multiple places, owned by less famous lords | 万魔殿是一片无边无际、充满痛苦与折磨的领域。虽然其中藏有许多宝藏，却由残酷的恶魔和更加残酷的恶魔领主把守。 深处遍布通往万魔殿的传送门。 万魔殿没有尽头。每个区域都有小概率出现返回地牢的传送门，或是直接返回，或是经由深渊返回。 万魔殿中可以找到不少于五种佐特符文： • 炽热符文位于塞雷波夫的烈焰领域 • 发光符文可在姆诺雷格受污染的领地中找到 • 魔法符文由洛姆·洛邦的奥术力量守护 • 黑暗符文藏在格洛克斯·弗洛克的暗影居所 • 恶魔符文散见多处，归名气较小的领主所有 | {"dynamic_parameters": null, "sink_kind": "TextDB description", "tokens": {"chinese": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}, "english": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}}, "translated_dynamic_parameters": null} | retained_textdb | description | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt | database.cc:getLongDescription | {"dynamic_parameters": null, "sink_kind": "TextDB description", "tokens": {"chinese": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}, "english": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}}, "translated_dynamic_parameters": null} | {"category": "world_description", "conditions": "lookup by retained English key; | `world_description:branches:sewer` | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt; database.cc:getLongDescription | lookup by retained English key; reachability reviewed separately; description | persistent=False; protocol=True | Every inhabited place needs to dispose of its waste products. The Dungeon too has its stinking sewers and drains, full of filthy water and ignored by most but used as hideaways by the disgusting and the desperate. Old tales speak of dangerous creatures stalking through the foul-smelling green water, preying on each other without mercy. | `world_description:branches:wizlab` | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt; database.cc:getLongDescription | lookup by retained English key; reachability reviewed separately; description | persistent=False; protocol=True | In ages past, the most powerful mages would frequently find or construct small realms sealed off from the rest of the world, where they could isolate themselves in the pursuit of ever-greater magical knowledge and power. | `world_description:branches:ziggurat` | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt; database.cc:getLongDescription | lookup by retained English key; reachability reviewed separately; description | persistent=False; protocol=True | A ziggurat is a strange tower constructed of incrementally larger combat arenas, each containing greater wealth and even greater danger than the last. Beware, for a ziggurat is not a place for the faint of heart: even the bravest and most skilled adventurers have met their ends in one. While a portal to safety will be present on every level, once left, a ziggurat cannot be re-entered. One ziggurat is guaranteed in the Depths. Tales tell of a magical item found at the bottom of each ziggurat, granting access to a new ziggurat in turn. Such an item is also said to be found at the bottom of the Tomb of the Ancients. Each time a ziggurat is conquered by exiting it from the final floor, subsequent ziggurats will become increasingly dangerous and lucrative. | 通天塔是一座奇异高塔，由一座座逐渐扩大的战斗场地构成；每一层都比上一层拥有更多财富，也更加危险。切记，通天塔不适合胆怯者：即使最勇敢、最娴熟的冒险者也曾命丧其中。每层都会有通往安全地带的传送门，但一旦离开，便无法重新进入同一座通天塔。 深处必定会出现一座通天塔。传说每座通天塔底部都有一件魔法物品，可依次通往下一座新的通天塔；据说远古陵墓底部也能找到这样的物品。每当冒险者从最终层出口征服一座通天塔，此后的通天塔都会变得更加危险，也更加有利可图。 | {"dynamic_parameters": null, "sink_kind": "TextDB description", "tokens": {"chinese": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}, "english": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}}, "translated_dynamic_parameters": null} | retained_textdb | description | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/branches.txt | database.cc:getLongDescription | {"dynamic_parameters": null, "sink_kind": "TextDB description", "tokens": {"chinese": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}, "english": {"entity_macros": [], "markup": [], "placeholders": []}}, "translated_dynamic_parameters": null} | {"category": "world_description", "conditions": "lookup by retained English key;
